top_concerns: The central claim that feature drift is an implicit augmentation supporting generalization is not tested by any controlled intervention; App. F.A/F.B are single-run, small and confounded.
The consistency metric is label-free and largely implied by >98% accuracy; no null baselines, mostly training-set evidence, and agreement on CIFAR-10C does not measure generalization.
SGD-noise claims (alignment with feature dynamics, correlation with memory window) have no supporting analysis; the spherical null is a weak test and the anisotropy is a known property.
Theory is conceptual: Theorem 1's TV term is uncomputed and possibly vacuous, and the NTK 'forgetting' argument in App. D does not follow.
Evidence is ResNet-20 on CIFAR-10 with no seeds or error bars, while the contributions claim results across datasets and architectures.
